text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Tactile handcrafted clay miniature environment, whimsical pastel doll-scale laundromat, rounded peach washing machines, empty mint folding tables, cream-yellow arched windows, tiny folded towels, visible clay fingerprints and soft stop-motion miniature lighting, camera at miniature room eye height, environment fills frame, no dolls.
